subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Men duty to God, parents and mankind. These help to follow them to be great. They are also helpful to make our life successful. So, we all have three important duties. They us go a long way.
guide_solution: (a) Men have three important duties. (b) These are duty to God, parents and mankind. (c) They help us go a long way. (d) They are also helpful to make our life successful. (e) So, we all have to follow them to be great.
